input: We did the two-day coastal ride at the weekend. Marek from work and his daughter Zofia came with me, and Zofia had a puncture before we were even a mile out of the car park.
She did. On the second day it rained so hard that we gave up at the ferry slip and got a lift back in a farmer's van with the bikes in the trailer.
The garage wants a yes or no on the clutch repair by Friday and I keep not ringing them back.
What did I tell you about the bike ride?
Sorry, I cut that short. Just remind me who rode with me.
And how did the second day turn out?
Leave the ride. It is the clutch business that is actually nagging at me today.
I think I will just ring them and say go ahead.
